It's a plug-in energy cost monitor plus the AC cable for your socket. It sits between the wall and the miner and shows watts, kWh and running cost on one screen, so you know exactly what the B30 costs to run. You enter your electricity rate once and it does the maths.

Yours is the EU version, matched to your address, and it was added to the order free of charge. It ships in the same box as the B30.
